spec.assertion: Trigger identity: every Victorious Battle Cry activation is tagged inside a Full Burst window (order-derived from fullBurstStart/fullBurstEnd), at least one activation follows >=30 landed damage events within its window, and some window holds >=2 activations. Fails under fullBurstEnter (one apply per window, at entry, ~0 damage before it) and under an ungated trigger (applies tagged outside FB). Counterfactual runNoFbGate (fbGate stripped from the hitCount block) must raise clay total and produce out-of-FB applies.

buffApply stat trueDamagePct, value 6.45 (plain percentage, not flat-resolved), maxStacks 3, observed stacks >1 and <=3. Fails under a missing cap (1 under-credits) or an uncapped/wrong cap. Load-bearing check: zeroing every trueDamagePct value drops clay total, proving the stack has a real true-flavored carrier.
The first activation sweep emits COMP.length applies with distinct targetSlugs, and the full set of targetSlugs equals the comp roster. Fails under a self-scoped or top-ATK-scoped target.
it.skip — no enemy-projectile entity exists at scope lock and no effect kind expresses damage dealt TO a projectile, so the line has no observable payload. Recorded so it is not a silent drop.

it.skip — the trigger (stageEnter stage 1, all allies) is expressible but its payload (debuff immunity to 1 debuff for 10 sec) has no primitive and the scope-lock boss applies no debuffs. Unobservable, so untestable.

spec.assertion: Scope: buffApply stat casterAtkPct from clay with a flat-resolved value >1000 and never near 20.07, and ZERO atkPct applies from clay near 20.07. Fails under the atkPct encoding (which would scale each ally own ATK and emit the raw 20.07).

spec.kitLine: only while in Victorious Battle Cry
spec.assertion: Window identity: clay casterAtkPct self-applies have the SAME count and the SAME sorted expiresFrame set as her Victorious Battle Cry true-damage self-applies, and all are tagged in-FB. Fails under an unconditional passive (single t=0 apply, unrelated expiry) or a mis-durationed grant. Counterfactual runAtkPassive (block retriggered as passive, durationSec dropped) must raise clay AND at least one teammate total.

Every clay casterAtkPct apply carries maxStacks 1 and stacks 1. Fails under the nearest-wrong that lets the ATK grant stack 3x alongside Victorious Battle Cry stacks (a 3x over-credit on the whole team).
Counterfactual runNoAtk (the 20.07 grant zeroed) drops clay total AND at least one teammate total. Fails under a self-scoped grant, which would leave every teammate byte-identical.

At least one full ally sweep of buffApply stat trueDamagePct value 12.56 from clay, covering the whole comp; also doubles as the non-vacuity proof that clay actually casts her burst in the control comp (she is Burst II sharing the stage). Buff keys are disjoint from the skill1 keys, proving the two true-damage grants coexist under the same-caster-slot overwrite rule rather than one replacing the other.

A trueNormals flag is set somewhere in the override (deep walk) — the only schema primitive for true-flavored normals is weaponSwap.trueNormals; flipping it false drops clay total (load-bearing) while leaving every teammate byte-identical (Affects self). Fails if the line is dropped entirely, or if it is mis-scoped to allies.

it.skip — the documented event payloads expose expiresFrame but no emission frame, so an absolute window LENGTH is not computable from the event log; duration semantics are instead pinned RELATIVELY (skill2 ATK expiry set == Victorious Battle Cry expiry set).

fixtures: controlComp('clay', true) for all 6 runs. The fixed B3 slot is REQUIRED and not optional here: clay is Burst II, so without a B3 the chain never completes and the team makes ZERO Full Bursts — which would make every skill1 assertion (all Full-Burst gated) silently vacuous. Deterministic (no seed). Runs: (1) base; (2) all trueDamagePct values zeroed; (3) the 20.07 ATK grant zeroed; (4) the ATK block retriggered as passive with durationSec dropped; (5) fbGate stripped from the hitCount block(s); (6) trueNormals flipped false. All counterfactuals are structure-agnostic — they locate effects by stat / trigger kind / flag name across all three slots and handle both possible slot shapes (Block[] or an object carrying blocks[]), and each asserts its own mutation count >0 so a no-op patch fails loudly instead of passing vacuously. Known fixture risk, stated rather than hidden: clay shares the Burst II stage with the control comp B2, so if she never wins the stage slot the burst-block test goes RED at 0 applies — that is the correct signal to re-cut the fixture, not to relax the assertion.
gaps: skill1 enemy-projectile rider (damage to that projectile ▲ 45.05% for 6 sec) — no projectile entity at scope lock and no effect kind expressing damage dealt to a projectile.

skill2 debuff immunity to 1 debuff for 10 sec on entering Burst Stage 1 — no immunity primitive in the effect schema; the scope-lock boss applies no debuffs, so the payload is unobservable (the stageEnter stage-1 trigger itself is expressible).

Absolute 6 sec / 10 sec window lengths in frames — buffApply exposes expiresFrame but no emission frame, so a window length cannot be derived from the event log alone; pinned relatively instead (ATK expiry set == Victorious Battle Cry expiry set).

⚑ Hit-counter carryover semantics: the kit says 60 normal attacks DURING Full Burst, but a hitCount trigger counts cumulative rounds and fbGate suppresses only the FIRING. Out-of-FB rounds therefore still advance the counter, so the first in-FB activation can land earlier than 60 in-window hits. Not assertable blind (no counter is exposed); the tests are written to tolerate it (max-over-activations rather than first-activation) and it is flagged as a modeling divergence worth a measured check.

⚑ SMG cadence (ammo 120 / reloadFrames 81 / rate) is a datamine-sourced field, so the exact number of 60-hit activations per 10s Full Burst window is not pinned — assertions use >=2 per window and >=30 damage events before an activation rather than exact counts.
